cohort: 3073 mother-infant pairs from the CHILD Cohort Study in Canada
finding: Cesarean section without labor events was associated with an increased risk of overweight at age 1 year, particularly in boys, but these effects did not persist to ages 3 or 5.
mod_finding: Infants born by CS without labor had increased odds of being overweight at age 1 year compared to vaginally delivered infants.
